final_message:
The yen receipt now renders correctly (`Paid ¥500 by card`), and all 18 tests pass.

The cause is the shared `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`, which divides every amount by 100. That's wrong for yen, which has no minor unit. The scope rule limits me to `src/payments`, so I left that file alone. Instead I added a small zero-decimal currency check in `src/payments/receipt.js`. It only knows JPY for now.

Invoices, cart and admin still call `formatMoney` and will show yen wrong (`¥5.00` for 500). The proper fix is in `money.js`, which the owning team would need to make. If they do, you can drop the workaround in `receipt.js`.
